_comment: The one declaration of the application's file and bundle names, its service labels, the external hosts the drivers talk to the developer source-mode names (the launcher Info.plist key a source build carries and the environment variable the launcher hands its runtime) and the field report names the three collectors share (tools/dev/collect-*-field-report.*: the field branch prefix, the report folder and the git config key that remembers the base of a field branch). tools/codegen/codegen-identifiers.cjs emits _shared/lua/identifiers.lua from it; Node tools read this file directly. tools/test/test-repo-url-single-source.cjs holds every other driver source to a shrinking baseline of typed copies. The GitHub owner and repository stay in _shared/modules/updater/defaults.json.
